message.content:
1. The pain and shortness of breath started after my catheter drainage failed last night. The pain is severe in my lower abdomen, and the shortness of breath has been getting progressively worse.

2. I have an indwelling pouch catheter that was placed for continuous drainage. When it failed last night, I noticed reduced urine coming out.
